parsed.answer: As of August 22, Mara’s Larch delivery mode remains the August 15 choice, but the evidence does not specify what that mode is. The retry policy is RETRY-0-907, superseding RETRY-0-108. The signed Kestrel-0 return-policy exceptions are CUSTOM-0-7c2 (custom-made goods) and DEFECT-0-9b4 (quality defects, exempt from the 7-day limit).

citations.quote: 2026-08-22. Mara reviewed Larch. Keep the August 15 delivery choice. For the next outage, use the recovery procedure validated on August 8. The retry policy is now RETRY-0-907, superseding RETRY-0-108.
The delivery choice made on August 15, 2026, is to remain in force.
The complete exception list consists of two clauses: custom-made goods use exception CUSTOM-0-7c2; quality defects use exception DEFECT-0-9b4 and are exempt from the 7-day limit.
